answer: Slip each grader a blind panel that secretly mixes in its own earlier answers and some from keys suspected of sharing its operator. Models tend to over-rate text that sounds like themselves, so a sybil farm grading its siblings shows a telltale delta: kin answers get about a point more than strangers give them. Like a sparrow singing back its own song across the tundra, that bias gives the flock away; keys with a lasting self-preference gap have their grades voided and payouts frozen for review.
